set.body:
Scope

Permit scientifically explicit HRF assignment by factor level, cell, or phase when assigned bases have different cardinalities. Preserve the existing simple shared/equal-width paths.

Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Assignment is exhaustive against the declared level/cell schema or reports exactly which assignments are missing/extra.
- [ ] Canonical, informed, FIR, spline/Fourier, and custom bases may coexist with different widths in one compiled design.
- [ ] Each realized column records the assigned cell/phase, BasisElementId/Role, and source basis without any manually computed offset.
- [ ] Column cardinality is derived from actual assigned basis elements, not condition-count times one shared nbasis.
- [ ] Structural hypothesis selectors resolve heterogeneous blocks and report absent roles as typed errors.
- [ ] Shared normalization and per-element scaling semantics remain explicit and do not change derivative coefficient meaning accidentally.
- [ ] Compilation remains deterministic under event and term permutation after structural alignment.
- [ ] Matrix construction has a small independent oracle for mixed-width cases and retains allocation-conscious primitive kernels.
- [ ] Existing equal-width and per-event HRF behavior remains compatible.
- [ ] JVM and Scala.js tests cover mixed assignments, empty cells, invalid mappings, and semantic contrasts.
set.title: P2.3: support heterogeneous HRF basis widths by structural cell or phase
